summary: Adlai Nortye Group Ltd., a NASDAQ-listed clinical-stage oncology biotech incorporated in Singapore, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Christopher Liu, PharmD, as Head of Investor Relations and Public Relations, effective immediately, per the September 30, 2026 release. Dr. Liu previously served as Managing Director of equity research at Lucid Capital Markets and held oncology research roles at Leerink Partners, Canaccord Genuity, and Oppenheimer. No financial terms, ownership stake, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine executive-hiring disclosure, not a forced or abrupt departure, and presents no structural or risk-arb angle.
